documents.text: National Action (Malta) National Action (, AN) was a right-wing Maltese political party active between 2007 and 2010. The party was founded in June 2007, the two most prominent founders being Josie Muscat, a medical doctor and entrepreneur and a former MP of the Nationalist Party, and real estate magnate Anġlu Xuereb. Muscat was elected National Action's first Leader. The party was best known for its position on immigration.
